hypotheses.reasoning: Alert origin chain: template-svc's calls to the third-party email provider (api.mailer.example) start failing around 05:58:56 (#2775 upstream 503), then hang: #2846 'no response within 10s' at 05:59:21, #2983 'read timed out after 10000 ms', and #3032 circuit breaker OPEN at 06:00:31 with 95% failure rate. Template-svc is the failing hop; notification-svc then fails with 'template-svc returned 503 (circuit open)' (#3174), and gateway 503s on POST /v1/notify take 25-28s (#2824, #2934), matching the hung-call pattern. Template-svc shows no internal resource problem (GC pauses small, heap 30-45%). The gateway 503s are downstream symptoms. The mix of fast 503s and 10s timeouts points to the mailer provider hanging or degrading; the logs contain no internal cause on our side.

The email provider returns explicit 503 Service Unavailable (#2874) and half-open probes keep failing with 503/502 (#3249, #3828), which reads as the third party being down rather than slow. The fix would then be failover or queueing notifications rather than tuning our timeouts.

verdict.recommendedAction: Confirm api.mailer.example status with the provider and check for an incident. Mitigate by failing over to a secondary email provider or queueing notify requests while the mailer is degraded. Keep the template-svc circuit breaker, and lower the 10s read timeout so gateway requests stop hanging for 25s+. Separately, audit-consumer is stuck on poison message msg-567751 (NUL byte at byte 1991, audit.events partition 7 offset 718634, #2859, #3179, #3295). Quarantine that message and fix producer escaping so the partition 7 lag (5000+ messages) drains. This is not the cause of the notify 503s.
